status: Retrospective revision protocol fixed before new analyses; not preregistered
main_estimand: Default loss minus frozen case-selected loss at 384 pixels; positive favors case selection
candidate_budgets: One configuration per implemented familiar family plus ECDF and five/19-marker task-matched controls for marginal tasks
default_training: 256-pixel losses only; leave one resource out for marginal, composition and profile tasks; leave one source patient out for single-source association
aggregation: Equal resource weighting; profile recording losses first average within source participant; association averages within source patient
uncertainty: 5000 paired cluster bootstrap resamples: resources for marginal/composition, patients for association; no bootstrap interval from only two profile sources
ties: Absolute loss tolerance 1e-12; deterministic candidate order only selects a deployable representative
failure: Any failed phase invalidates a candidate; selected/default failures and paired-valid denominators reported separately
synthetic_design: 36 two-group cases (six regimes x two sample sizes x three replicates), 48 compositions (four counts x three concentrations x four replicates), 36 profiles (three shapes x three amplitudes x four replicates), 36 associations (three correlations x three sample sizes x four replicates)
synthetic_default: Freeze one task-specific default from all empirical 256-pixel results before generating synthetic results; report separately from empirical tests
synthetic_interpretation: Newly generated computational stress cases. Design informed by earlier results; not untouched external populations or prospective reader validation
decoder_sensitivity: Independent composition extraction using radial angular samples, bar endpoints and central stacked-bar lengths; all 24 empirical and 48 existing synthetic compositions, both display sizes and four phases
display_sensitivity: 256 to 384 pixels plus changed phases. This is a joint display-condition transfer, not a causal isolation of resolution
examples: Retain the eight illustrative families in a supplementary gallery only; primary figures summarize full benchmark and matched controls
inference: No pooled score across tasks, no claims about reader comprehension, no forced winners
